findings.description: Found 1 database query (Prisma.upsert()) inside a for-of loop. This creates an N+1 query problem where each iteration makes a separate database call. Consider using eager loading or batch queries instead.

estimatedImpact.description: 101 queries for 100 items vs 1 optimal query

solutions.reasoning:
Extract queries from loop and batch them before iteration
